## Details

<a id="old_scene_bitmap_ptrs"></a>
### [`old_scene_bitmap_ptrs`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_1281.asm#L6) `$1281-$1288`

*data*

Unused old table of 4 words: $e640, $3600, $4500, $5400. These are unpacked scene bitmaps of $f00 bytes; scene 0 sat at its screen place.

<a id="old_scene_colour_ptrs"></a>
### [`old_scene_colour_ptrs`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_1281.asm#L9) `$1289-$1290`

*data*

Unused table of 4 words: the v1 colour maps at $6300-$6a7f. v2 packs the maps at $68cb, so nothing reads this table now.

<a id="old_scene_screen_ptrs"></a>
### [`old_scene_screen_ptrs`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_1281.asm#L12) `$1291-$1298`

*data*

Unused table of 4 words: the v1 screen maps at $6a80-$71ff. The nibble unpacker at $1849 uses scene_map_packed_ptrs in its place.
